template_question: Create a new email to [recipient] with subject [subject] and body [body].
llm_output_expectation: Created new emails to various recipients with subjects related to meetings and projects, containing messages about agendas, schedules, and project discussions.
template_prompts: Create a new email to john.doe@example.com with subject Meeting update and body Please find the attached agenda for our meeting..
Create a new email to j.doe@mail.com with subject Schedule confirmation and body Looking forward to your feedback on the proposal..
Create a new email to johnny.d@example.org with subject Project discussion and body Let me know if you have any questions about the project..

individual_run_test_results.prompt: Create a new email to john.doe@example.com with subject Meeting update and body Please find the attached agenda for our meeting..
individual_run_test_results.agent_output:
Tool Failure Error: AppleScript execution failed: Command failed: osascript -e '
        set recipient to "john.doe@example.com"
        set subject to "Meeting update"
        set body to "Please find the attached agenda for our meeting."

        -- URL encode subject and body
        set encodedSubject to my urlEncode(subject)
        set encodedBody to my urlEncode(body)

        -- Construct the mailto URL
        set mailtoURL to "mailto:" & recipient & "?subject=" & encodedSubject & "&body=" & encodedBody

        -- Use Apple Mail'"'"'s '"'"'mailto'"'"' command to create the email
        tell application "Mail"
          mailto mailtoURL
          activate
        end tell

        -- Handler to URL-encode text
        on urlEncode(theText)
          set theEncodedText to ""
          set theChars to every character of theText
          repeat with aChar in theChars
            set charCode to ASCII number aChar
            if charCode = 32 then
              set theEncodedText to theEncodedText & "%20" -- Space
            else if (charCode ≥ 48 and charCode ≤ 57) or (charCode ≥ 65 and charCode ≤ 90) or (charCode ≥ 97 and charCode ≤ 122) or charCode = 45 or charCode = 46 or charCode = 95 or charCode = 126 then
              -- Allowed characters: A-Z, a-z, 0-9, -, ., _, ~
              set theEncodedText to theEncodedText & aChar
            else
              -- Convert to %HH format
              set hexCode to do shell script "printf '"'"'%02X'"'"' " & charCode
              set theEncodedText to theEncodedText & "%" & hexCode
            end if
          end repeat
          return theEncodedText
        end urlEncode
      '
/bin/sh: 1: osascript: not found
